# Provisional profile for the BASE game (cart's Application meta, 1.0.0) from profile_guess.py
# the cart's on-cart update is a different build set: main 0c00fc37b0610fbd, sdk 1ea0b9fe6cd6867b, SDK 17.5.4, RomFS 13.21 GB merged
# mem_reserve 0x1028000000 (62 GB) is Unreal's nninitStartup region; ue_malloc.py cuts the allocator and ue_region.py gives an iPhone what the alias region has room for
# sys_resource 0x1000000 = the NPDM's 16 MB, so virtual address memory is on
modules	main subsdk0 sdk
# The block the HOST reserves, not what the game asks for: the game asks 0x1028000000 (64 GB) at nninitStartup and the rewriter's engine-wide gate on that store (dm/tools/ue_region.py)
# hands it the alias region's room instead. 0xF0000000 / alias 0xC8000000 is the pairing both UE 4.2x profiles on hand use with this same app_pool 0xCD500000 (OCTOPATH TRAVELER II, Mario & Luigi: Brothership):
# 256 MB front + 3.125 GB alias + 256 MB stack + 128 MB heap region
mem_reserve	0xF0000000
mem_alias	0xC8000000
mem_stack	0x10000000
app_pool	0xCD500000
sys_resource	0x1000000
